body: Founder, real-time: 'continue REDGARDEN backlog make sure there are spell animations.' S170-124 shipped with 5 passing headless tests, but those only prove cast_flash_slot gets set correctly in isolation. Added a temporary server-side log line, rebuilt, restarted live, ran a real 20/20 match: confirmed cast_flash_slot=1 (Q) firing continuously across many heroes for the full check window, driven by apps/arena_bot's own periodic Q-cast heuristic. Removed the temp log line afterward (git diff confirms zero net change, nothing was ever committed) and restarted live services back to clean state. Verification-only pass, no functional code change.
title: Verified spell animations fire live, not just in headless tests (S170-126)
